verdict.rationale: skills.sh documents a single package-manager one-liner, `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`, that installs a skill collection into the agent's project or global skills directory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. The agentskills.io docs state that agents load available skills at startup, which covers the next-session part of the story, and a runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly from npm. missing for 10: hands-on verification that an installed skill is actually picked up in a fresh agent session (the probe only ran --version and --list, not a full install-then-activate test).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: Install them with a single command to enhance your agents with access to procedural knowledge.
At startup, agents load only the name and description of each available skill, just enough to know when it might be relevant.
the skills CLI ran keylessly from npm
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills -a claude-code -a opencode
